attendance.title: Attendance — lesson {number}
attendance.confirmed: Confirmed — lessons were spent according to attendance.
attendance.empty: No data from the classroom yet. Confirming marks everyone by hand (absent by default).

errors.unknown: Could not confirm. Please try again.

replay.emptyHint: Recordings of past lessons will show up here.

payroll.title: Payroll periods

errors.hr_period_overlaps: This period overlaps an existing one.
errors.unknown: Could not complete the action. Please try again.

payroll.description: Opening a period approves draft hours up to its end; locking freezes the amounts.
payroll.createHint: Every draft up to the end date (including late ones from earlier periods) joins this period.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Each branch has its own time zone — schedules show in branch time.
branches.timeZoneEditHint: A new time zone applies to classes opened afterwards; existing classes keep theirs.
branches.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate the branch? Its classes go on, but no new classes or rooms.

staff.title: Staff
staff.initialPassword: Initial password (leave empty for an existing account)
staff.rateHint: Applies to lessons from the effective date; approved or locked hours never change.
staff.createHint: Branch managers and coordinators can be limited to branches afterwards (Edit).
staff.rateEditHint: A rate can be corrected or deleted while no approved or locked timesheet uses it.
staff.rateDeleteConfirm: Delete this rate? Draft timesheets are re-priced.
staff.deactivateConfirm: Suspend the account? They can no longer sign in; history and assignments stay.
staff.branchScopeHint: No branch ticked = the whole center.

programs.title: Programs
programs.heading: {code} · {name} ({language}, {framework})
programs.description: Programs per language and framework, split into levels.
programs.lockedHint: Language and framework are fixed once levels exist.
programs.sessionCountHint: Fixed once a class uses this level.
programs.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate the program? Hidden from the public site, no new classes; existing classes go on.
programs.deactivateLevelConfirm: Deactivate the level? No new classes at this level.

classes.title: Classes
classes.notScheduled: No schedule yet. Pick weekdays and a start time to generate the lessons.
classes.enrollHint: Students join the class when an order for the class is paid (Billing page).
classes.description: Open classes, schedule them and track seats.
classes.createHint: After opening the class, schedule it from its page.
classes.editHint: Level, branch and start date can change only before the class is scheduled; the level also needs an empty class.
classes.lockedHint: Locked: the class is scheduled or has students.
classes.modeHint: Applies to sessions not yet held.
classes.completeConfirm: Complete the class? Sessions not yet held will be cancelled.
classes.cancelConfirm: Cancel the class? Sessions not yet held will be cancelled and teachers and rooms freed.
classes.replanHint: Sessions not yet held from the effective date move to the new days, time, teacher and room, keeping the lesson order.
classes.notScheduledReadOnly: The class has no schedule yet.

students.title: Students
students.description: Student records; issue an account so they can use the learner portal.
students.createHint: With an account, the username and temporary password show only once — pass them on.
students.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate the record? The student cannot buy or enroll again; history stays.

billing.title: Billing
billing.orderHint: Orders for a class enroll the student once fully paid.
billing.packageEditHint: A new price applies to new orders; existing orders keep theirs.
billing.deactivatePackageConfirm: Stop selling this package? Existing orders stay.
billing.refundDescription: Unused paid lessons × unit price are refunded; bonus lessons are not. You may change the suggested amount — give the reason.

refundKinds.ClassUnavailable: Class could not take the student

billing.quoteNotRefundable: This order cannot be refunded in its current state.
billing.refundAmountHint: At most {max}. If it differs from the suggestion, explain below.
billing.refundReasonHint: Printed on the refund voucher and kept in the lesson ledger.
billing.ledgerEmpty: No lessons in the ledger yet (the order is not fully paid).
billing.ledgerHint: Append-only: every change is a new line.

history.title: Change history

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate the room? Planned sessions keep it; new schedules cannot pick it.

holidays.hint: Used when a schedule is planned or re-planned; planned sessions do not move by themselves.

lobby.heading: Check your camera and microphone before class
lobby.hint: Pick your devices, speak to see the level bar, then press Join. You can turn the mic and camera on or off in the room too.
lobby.cameraDenied: The browser does not allow the camera
lobby.micMissing: No microphone found: you can still join to watch, listen and chat.
lobby.permissionDenied: The browser is blocking the camera/microphone. Click the lock icon next to the address to allow them and reload, or just join to watch, listen and chat.
lobby.limit: The online classroom connects devices directly to each other, so rooms are limited to keep video quality (usually up to 6 people, teacher included).

controls.endConfirm: End the class for everyone? Nobody can enter this room again afterwards.

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Messages only reach people in the room right now and are not saved.

ended.title: The class has ended
ended.body: Everyone's time in the room has been recorded for attendance and timesheets.

left.title: You left the room
left.body: You can rejoin while the class is still going.

errors.session_expired: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then press Join class.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong connecting to the room. Please try again.
errors.media: Could not open the camera, microphone or screen. Check the browser's permissions and try again.

notifications.title: Notification log
notifications.description: Emails the system sends to students, teachers and staff. Temporary failures are retried automatically; permanent ones (wrong address, unknown mailbox) stop so you can check and resend.
